answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the jetty of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the summit of a task receipt, and the violet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
